decisions.proposal: Explicit native system and exact seed; one-reply baseline or <=4opportunities using literal host cue; no STOP grammar or mandatory response schema.

decisions.revision: Round2 human checkpoint wording must not impose new per-call user approval or quality gate; operator checks remain within any authorized finite window; actual pauses attributed.

decisions.proposal: Preserve carrier but retain independent-consequence choice; mechanical/interlocutor overlay not silently selected.

decisions.revision: Optional reciprocal repair justified as design affordance; identifiability relative to full allowed evidence is prerequisite; no efficacy claim or further expansion.
